comparison.objective: Chock a rolling cradle before unloading it; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Place two chocks and perform a restrained lift versus tool insertion, fine collar rotation, bimanual counterhold, and iterative response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Both chocks remain seated while the load moves versus two safe, repeatable dynamic stops and retained collar setting. Chock record gives no seating tolerances.
comparison.reason: Static stabilization-before-removal does not test damper commissioning.
